_meta._BASIS_AUDIT_ACROSS_ALL_SEVEN_BLOCKS_202: SYSTEMATIC AUDIT RUN AFTER THE KDH ERROR, TO BOUND IT. Every Q1/Q2/H1 numeric field in every ticker block was extracted and every derivable triple re-checked. THE RESULT IS REASSURING AND THE DIAGNOSIS IS SHARPER THAN THE ONE WRITTEN AN HOUR AGO. WHAT RECONCILES: HPG npat 9,056 + 6,424 = 15,480 EXACT. MBB reconciles FOUR WAYS - PBT 9,628 + 10,560 = 20,188; NPAT-to-parent 7,515.52 + 8,229.06 = 15,744.58; TOI 17,430 + 20,434.31 = 37,865; opex 4,347 + 5,627 = 9,974. HPG's core/total bridge also holds: H1 total 15,480 minus the 4,123 Q1 gain gives 11,357, which is what the file states. TCB, VPB, TCX and VPX carry ONLY h1_pbt with no quarterly split, so no derivation was possible and none was made. SO KDH WAS THE ONLY PLACE THE ERROR OCCURRED. The damage is bounded to one ticker. AND THE REAL DIAGNOSIS IS A NAMING CONVENTION, WHICH ONE BLOCK ALREADY DEMONSTRATES. THE KDH FAILURE WAS NOT ARITHMETIC - 327 minus 321 computes fine. It was that q1_npat (CONSOLIDATED) and h1_npat (CORE OR PARENT) CARRY NO BASIS IN THEIR NAMES, so nothing signalled that pairing them was invalid. WORSE, THE TWO HAPPENED TO SIT WITHIN 2% OF EACH OTHER BY COINCIDENCE, so the invalid pairing produced 'Q2 is roughly zero' - a number that is dramatic but coherent, rather than absurd. AN ABSURD RESULT WOULD HAVE BEEN CAUGHT IMMEDIATELY; A PLAUSIBLE ONE SURVIVED TEN DAYS. MBB'S BLOCK IS THE COUNTER-EXAMPLE AND THE FIX. It carries q1_npat AND q1_npat_parent, q1_pbt AND q1_pbt_parent, h1_npat_parent - THE BASIS IS IN THE FIELD NAME, so a mismatched pairing is visible before it is computed. That convention would have made the KDH error impossible to write. THE ONE LATENT MISMATCH LEFT, ALREADY KNOWN AND HANDLED IN PROSE BUT NOT IN NAMES: HPG's actuals (q1/q2/h1_npat) are TOTAL while fy26e_npat is explicitly CORE, ex the divestment gain. The file states this and does its branch comparison on core, so no error has been made - BUT THE PROTECTION IS A SENTENCE, NOT A FIELD NAME, and the sentence is the thing that fails at 3am. RECOMMENDED TO A HUMAN: rename to the MBB convention across all blocks. That is a schema change and therefore human-only under charter s4.

valuation._note: The bridge from earnings scenarios to DECISIONS. Return_s = (exit_multiple_s x fy26e_npat_s) / market_cap_now - 1 + cash_yield. Working in market-cap space avoids share-count drift (the HPG/TCX stock-dividend trap). exit_multiple is the single biggest judgment call in this file: it is where 'what is it worth' lives. probs are Layer-2 beliefs; confidence is the evidence-quality shrink applied to expected return (see decide.py).
valuation._npat_ttm_method: DERIVED FROM THE EARNINGS PATH, not from a guessed share count: npat_ttm = H1_26 + H2_25, where H1_25 = H1_26/(1+yoy) and H2_25 ~ H1_25 x 1.05 seasonality. This keeps npat_ttm internally consistent with the same H1 actuals the scenarios are built on. An earlier version derived it from estimated share counts and put MBB's TTM base ~35% too low, which made a normal bank look like a +85% expected return. Cross-check whenever prices refresh: pe_ttm x npat_ttm should land within ~5% of shares x price.

TCB._THE_LARGEST_POSITION_CARRIES_THE_LARGES: FINISHED THE SWEEP THE 09:53 LESSON DEMANDED, AND THE BIGGEST ONE WAS LAST. VERIFIED TWICE, BY TWO DIFFERENT ROUTES IN ONE DISCLOSURE. (1) The 7% cash dividend is VND700 per share for a TOTAL OUTLAY OF 4,960bn. 4,960bn / 700 = 7,085.7m SHARES against the 7,086,200,000 on file - 0.0069%. (2) The 60% bonus is reported as increasing charter capital by 42,517bn. 42,517bn / VND10,000 par = 4,251.7m shares, WHICH IS EXACTLY 60% OF THE FILE'S COUNT. TWO INDEPENDENT DIVISIONS, TWO EXACT MATCHES. AND A THIRD FIGURE IN THE SAME REPORT DISAGREES, WHICH IS WHY THIS IS WORTH WRITING DOWN. The coverage also says the bank will issue 'HON 4,28 TY' shares - MORE THAN 4.28 BILLION. 4,280m x 10,000 = 42,800bn, WHICH CONTRADICTS THE 42,517bn IN THE SAME REPORT BY 283bn. Three values, and the TWO THAT AGREE WERE DERIVED BY DIFFERENT ROUTES (a cash total divided by a per-share rate, and a charter-capital increase divided by par) WHILE THE OUTLIER IS THE LOOSE PROSE FIGURE. The file's count is taken as confirmed and the 4.28bn is not adopted. A THIRD INPUT CONFIRMED IN PASSING: cash_yield. VND700 / VND29,250 = 2.393%, against the 2.4% on file. TCB IS THE ONLY NAME WITH A POPULATED cash_yield and it is right. THE PENDING DILUTION IS THE LARGEST IN THE BOOK, ON THE LARGEST POSITION. 7,086.2m -> 11,337.9m SHARES, +60.0%, charter capital 70,862bn -> 113,379bn against a reported '>113,000bn'. TCB IS 35.0% OF THE BOOK. THE THREE-BANK PICTURE, NOW COMPLETE. TCB 35.0% of the book with +60.0% pending; VPB 10.0% with +33.9%; MBB 6.5% with +27.5%. THAT IS 51.5% OF THE BOOK - EXACTLY THE BANK BLOCK - ALL THREE CARRYING LARGE PENDING SHARE INCREASES. ONE-LEGGED REFRESH ERRORS: TCB E[r] +4.0% -> -35.0%, A MOVE OF -39.0pp; VPB -13.9% -> -35.7%, -21.8pp; MBB +36.6% -> +7.1%, -29.5pp. ALL THREE ARE TWO TO FOUR TIMES THE 10pp ESCALATION THRESHOLD AND TCB'S IS THE LARGEST SINGLE MISPRICING AVAILABLE TO THIS MODEL. FIVE OF EIGHT SHARE COUNTS ARE NOW EXTERNALLY CONFIRMED - VCI, TCX, MBB, VPB, TCB - AND ALL FIVE PASSED. REMAINING UNVERIFIED: HPG (16.8%), KDH (20.3%), VPX (2.8%). Neither HPG nor KDH has a pending share issue on file, which is why they rank behind the banks, but 37.1% of the book still rests on charter-capital-over-par arithmetic alone. NOTHING MODELLED. No count, price, branch, probability or confidence touched; no ex-date is established for either TCB tranche. This VERIFIES inputs and SIZES a hazard already written onto OPEN-DECISIONS item 2.

VPB._SHARE_COUNT_VERIFIED_AND_THE_WATCH_LIST: APPLIED YESTERDAY'S MBB CHECK TO VPB. THE COUNT VERIFIES AND THE WATCH LIST'S DESCRIPTION OF THE PLACEMENT DOES NOT. VERIFIED, BY THE TECHNIQUE THAT HAS NOW WORKED FOUR TIMES. VPB's 5% cash dividend is VND500 per share for a TOTAL OUTLAY OF ABOUT 3,967bn. 3,967bn / 500 = 7,934.0m SHARES. THIS FILE CARRIES 7,933,900,000 - A DIFFERENCE OF 0.0013%. A total amount divided by a per-share amount is a dated share count, the same route that confirmed KDH (01-Aug), VCI (03-Aug) and now VPB. FOUR OF EIGHT ARE NOW EXTERNALLY CONFIRMED - VCI, TCX, MBB, VPB - AND ALL FOUR CHECKS PASSED. THE FULL 2026 CAPITAL PLAN, AND EVERY TRANCHE RECONCILES TO THE SAME BASE. 26% STOCK DIVIDEND: 7,933.9m x 0.26 = 2,062.8m against a reported 'gan 2,07 ty', funded from >20,660bn of undistributed profit against a par value of 20,628bn, taking charter capital to 99,967bn against a reported ~100,000bn. THEN A PRIVATE PLACEMENT TO FOREIGN INVESTORS OF MORE THAN 624 MILLION SHARES, taking charter capital to 106,207bn against a reported '>106,200bn'. TOTAL: 7,933.9m -> 10,620.7m SHARES, +33.9%. AND HERE IS THE PART THAT MATTERS, BECAUSE IT IS AN ERROR INSIDE THE ROUTINE'S OWN WATCH LIST. THE WATCH LIST TRACKS 'VPB 26% stock dividend + $250m foreign placement'. 624m SHARES x VND10,000 PAR = 6,240bn = ABOUT US$237m AT 26,300 - WHICH IS THE '$250m'. SO THE $250m IS THE CHARTER-CAPITAL EFFECT, NOT THE MONEY RAISED. At anything above par the actual proceeds are larger; at the file's price of 25,000 the same 624m shares would be 15,600bn, ABOUT US$593m. THE ISSUE PRICE IS NOT ESTABLISHED AND IS NOT GUESSED - what is established is that a par-value figure has been carried as a raise. SECOND INSTANCE IN TWO SWEEPS OF THE SAME TRAP. Yesterday 08:53 caught MBB's placement described as 'adding approximately 2,000bn in capital', which is 200m x par. THE TELL BOTH TIMES WAS THAT THE FIGURE DIVIDED EXACTLY BY PAR. In Vietnamese capital-raise disclosures charter capital moves by par x shares regardless of issue price, so ANY 'adds X bn in capital' figure is a share-count statement in currency clothing. THE HAZARD, SIZED. VPB's E[r] is -13.9%. Updating shares by +33.9% while leaving the price unchanged takes it to -35.7%, A MOVE OF -21.8pp, above the 10pp escalation threshold. COMBINED WITH MBB: TWO NAMES, 16.5% OF THE BOOK, CARRYING PENDING SHARE INCREASES OF +27.5% AND +33.9%, AND A ONE-LEGGED PRICE REFRESH ON EITHER FIRES TRIGGER 3. VPB's increase is the LARGER of the two and its weight is the larger too. NOTHING MODELLED. Share count, price, branches, probabilities and confidence untouched - this VERIFIES an input and corrects a DESCRIPTION, and no ex-date is established for any tranche.

KDH._CONFIDENCE_NOT_RAISED_2026_07_30: A DELIBERATE DEVIATION FROM THE ROUTINE'S OWN INSTRUCTION, AND THE REASON MATTERS MORE THAN THE DECISION. The hourly routine says an estimate becoming a filed actual should move confidence UP. Applied mechanically here, 0.50 -> 0.60, IT PRODUCED A PERVERSE RESULT: KDH's shrunk expected return ROSE from +8.1% to +9.7% and it climbed from 5th to 4th in the book - REWARDED FOR A PRINT THAT MISSED EVERY STREET ESTIMATE AND DELIVERED ROUGHLY ZERO PROFIT. WHY THE RULE MISFIRES HERE. confidence MULTIPLIES fy26e_npat. The rule assumes the branches are re-derived at the same time as confidence is raised. THEY CANNOT BE: re-deriving scenario branches is a judgment change reserved for a human under charter s2, and this run may not make it. So raising confidence alone amplifies branches the same print has just contradicted - it makes the engine MORE wrong, with more conviction. THE UNDERLYING PROBLEM IS THAT ONE FIELD CARRIES TWO MEANINGS. Confidence in the TRAILING data genuinely rose - Q2 is a filed fact now. Confidence in the FORWARD branches genuinely FELL - H1 profit is 13-21% of the company's own 1,500-2,500bn plan and the bear branch needs ~70 more units in H2 against ~10 handed in H1. A single scalar cannot move in two directions, and when it is forced to, it should not move in the direction that flatters. SO CONFIDENCE IS HELD AT 0.50 and the whole thing is escalated instead. Charter s5 is explicit: where evidence contradicts a THESIS rather than a number, do not quietly retune - say so and escalate. RAISING CONFIDENCE WOULD HAVE BEEN THE QUIET RETUNE. This is recorded as a deviation so a human can overrule it, and as a note that the routine's rule needs a caveat for the case where branches cannot be revised in the same run.

_LOOKTHROUGH_EXPOSURE_2026_07_27._THE_LOOKTHROUGH_ITSELF_UNDERSTATES_IT_A:
STRUCTURE SWEEP, PASS 6. ONE NUMBER WAS MISSING FROM THIS FILE AND IT DOUBLES THE HEADLINE FINDING OF THIS VERY ENTRY. TECHCOMBANK OWNS 94.17% OF TCBS - raised from 88.7% to ~94% through an issue TCB alone subscribed. THE OWNERSHIP PERCENTAGE APPEARS NOWHERE IN THIS REPO.

WHAT IT DOES, ARITHMETICALLY, USING ONLY FIELDS ALREADY ON FILE. TCX MARKET CAP 114,007bn x 94.17% = 107,360bn. TCB'S OWN MARKET CAP IS 207,271bn. SO TCB'S STAKE IN TCX IS WORTH 51.8% OF TCB'S ENTIRE MARKET CAPITALISATION. AGAINST THAT, TCX CONTRIBUTES 19.8% OF TCB'S TTM NPAT (5,687 of 28,754) - which independently corroborates the 19.2% PBT share this entry already used. THE CAUSE IS THE MULTIPLE: TCX TRADES AT 20.05x AND TCB AT 7.21x, A GAP OF 2.78 TIMES. A subsidiary supplying a fifth of the earnings is worth half the parent because the market pays 2.78x the multiple for it.

AND THAT IS A METHODOLOGICAL ERROR IN THIS ENTRY'S OWN ESCALATION. This block computes effective_broker_pct.TCX = 12.23 as 5.5 direct + 35.0 x 19.2% - i.e. IT USES AN EARNINGS SHARE TO SCALE A PORTFOLIO WEIGHT. A PORTFOLIO WEIGHT IS A MARKET-VALUE CONCEPT. On the market-value share the indirect exposure is 35.0 x 51.8% = 18.13pp, SO TCX IS 23.63% OF THE BOOK, NOT 12.23%. TOTAL EFFECTIVE BROKERAGE BECOMES 23.63 + VPX 4.22 + VCI 3.1 = 30.95%, AGAINST THE 19.54% THIS ENTRY ESCALATED AND THE 11.4% THE CLUSTER MAP STATES. THE ENTRY'S HEADLINE - 'the cluster map understates industry concentration by 71%' - IS ITSELF AN UNDERSTATEMENT. The true understatement against the stated 11.4% is about 2.7x. VPX'S 4.22 IS LEFT UNTOUCHED BECAUSE VPB'S OWNERSHIP PERCENTAGE OF VPBANKS IS NOT ESTABLISHED - the same gap, one name over, and it is now a named to-do rather than an invisible one.

WHAT THIS DOES TO THE PROPOSED TRADE, WHICH IS WHY IT IS ESCALATED. This entry says 'the optimizer's +5.1pp TCX add starts from an effective 12.2%, not 5.5%, and would take broker exposure to ~25% of the book'. ON A MARKET-VALUE LOOK-THROUGH IT STARTS FROM ~23.6% AND WOULD TAKE BROKER EXPOSURE TO ABOUT 36%. Against a 20% cluster cap. NOT ACTED ON - optimizer config and cluster definitions are human-only under charter s4.

TWO READINGS OF THE 51.8%, AND I DO NOT CHOOSE. (a) TCX IS EXPENSIVE at 20.05x and TCB's price simply does not capitalise the stake at TCX's own market price. (b) TCB IS CHEAP - the residual bank, stripping the stake at market, is 99,911bn on 23,067bn of ex-TCX earnings, WHICH IS 4.33x. A TEMPTING THIRD ARGUMENT IS DISCARDED HERE AS TAUTOLOGICAL: re-valuing the stake at TCB's OWN multiple makes the residual bank's multiple equal TCB's multiple, but that is an algebraic identity for any subsidiary and any parent, not evidence of anything. IT LOOKED LIKE A CONFIRMATION AND IS NOT ONE.

CAVEATS THAT MATTER. Both caps rest on the file's UNDATED prices (item 2); a common date error largely cancels in the RATIO but not in the levels. TCX's cap depends on the corrected 2,773.9m share count verified 04-Aug. The 94.17% is T5 press, and the same summary also says 'increased from 88.7% to 94%' - 94.17 is used and the rounding is noted. AND THE FOUR PENDING SHARE-COUNT INCREASES (item 2) TOUCH BOTH SIDES: TCB's 60% bonus is value-neutral for market cap, so the RATIO survives it, but the arithmetic should be re-run once prices are dated.

ALSO FOUND, RECORDED NOT PURSUED: TCBS is establishing an 800bn SUBSIDIARY AT THE HO CHI MINH CITY INTERNATIONAL FINANCIAL CENTRE, and separately paid ~845m for 9.9% of a technology company. AND A DATE FOR THE STALE COUNT: TCX'S 2,311,308,021 SHARES BEGAN TRADING 21-OCTOBER-2025 - item 24 discussed that count without ever dating its listing.

NOTHING MODELLED. No weight, branch, probability, price or confidence moved. The corrected look-through is stated, not applied.

This file derives Q1 core as q1_pbt 355.7 minus q1_bargain_gain 285.2 = 70.5bn, on a PBT basis. The source's 53bn is 75.2% of that, which is close to an after-tax reading but NOT clean: Vietnam CIT is 20%, and 70.5 x 0.80 = 56.4, not 53. The residual is ~3.4bn, or an effective rate of 24.8%. THREE READINGS SURVIVE: the 53bn is core NPAT with a minority-interest deduction; the source strips more from 'core' than just the bargain gain; or the bargain gain is not entirely pre-tax. THIS IS THE SAME SHAPE AS HPG's 113bn gap - a core-plus-one-off that does not quite reconcile to the headline, and in both cases the unresolved item is whether the one-off is pre- or post-tax. NOT RESOLVED, nothing overwritten, and KDH remains UNFILED as of 15:54 ICT 29-Jul.

actuals._q1_revenue_RESOLVED_THE_FIELD_WAS_RIGHT: RESOLVED, AND MY CONCLUSION WAS WRONG. q1_revenue = 281.4 IS CORRECT AND IS REVENUE. A source this sweep states it explicitly and with the matching decimal: KDH recorded NET REVENUE (doanh thu thuan) of approximately 281.4bn in Q1/2026, DOWN 60.4% YoY, while AFTER-TAX PROFIT rose to MORE THAN 327bn, up about 175.5%. So revenue is 281.4 and profit is 327 - two different numbers, and this file had the right one in the right field all along. WHAT I GOT WRONG, AND HOW. Across 28-Jul and 29-Jul I built an increasingly confident case that 281.4 was mislabelled net profit, ending at 'THREE ROUTES NOW AGREE'. All three were weaker than I treated them, and all three trace back to the same ambiguous press phrasing rather than to three independent observations: (1) ARITHMETIC: q1_pbt 355.7 x 0.79 = 281.0. That is NOT 281.4. I treated a near-match as a match. The exact decimal 281.4 appearing in a source that calls it doanh thu thuan is decisive against it. (2) THE GROWTH RATE: I argued '+131% attaches to 281 wherever it appears'. The growth rate actually attaching to Q1 PROFIT is +175.5%, on a base of 327 - a different rate on a different number. (3) THE 'DECLINING REVENUE' CLAUSE, which I called decisive on 29-Jul. The source said revenue DECLINED and mentioned 281 in the same breath. Revenue declined TO 281.4. I read it as 'revenue declined, and separately profit was 281'. THE CLAUSE MEANT THE OPPOSITE OF WHAT I TOOK IT TO MEAN. THE COUNTER-ARGUMENT ON FILE WAS RIGHT AND I DISMISSED IT. The original note said 6 units at an ASP of 42-44bn implies revenue of 252-264bn, 'close enough to 281.4 that a genuine revenue figure is not impossible'. That reconciles well - revenue slightly above unit sales, consistent with other revenue lines. I let three weak confirmations override one sound arithmetic check. THE LESSON, and it is not the period/entity/measure one: THREE ROUTES THAT ALL TRACE TO THE SAME AMBIGUOUS SOURCE PHRASING ARE ONE ROUTE COUNTED THREE TIMES. Independence has to be checked, not assumed, and the count of confirmations is not the strength of the evidence. WHAT IT RESTORES. The 28-Jul note claimed the pre-registered Q2 read had lost its second verification route because 'we do not have a revenue figure at all'. WE DO. The revenue route exists and is available for today's print. dossiers/KDH.md section 3 instructs checking the Q2 units count from BOTH the Gladia inventory movement AND the revenue line - both are live. ALSO ADDED: q1_npat 327 (new field, was never recorded) and q1_revenue_yoy -0.604. Note PBT 355.7 against NPAT 327 implies tax of 28.7bn, an 8.1% effective rate - low, and consistent with a largely non-taxable bargain-purchase gain, but not exactly reproducible. Flagged, not resolved. OPEN-DECISIONS item 14 is now ANSWERED: the field is revenue, no change needed.

actuals._BACKLOG_BOUNDS_THE_BULL_BRANCH_2026_07_: A SECOND QUANTITATIVE ROUTE TO THE BULL-INFEASIBILITY FINDING, from a different house and a different measure. Vietcap puts the GLADIA BACKLOG AT 3,100bn AT END-2025, described as ~44% of forecast 2026 revenue - which back-solves to a full-year revenue forecast of ~7,045bn, consistent with the ~7,160bn seen from another source. Tier T5, press reporting a named house. CONVERTED ONTO OUR UNIT ECONOMICS: 3,100bn at an ASP of 42-44bn per unit is 70.5 to 73.8 UNITS of contracted-but-unrecognised Gladia inventory entering 2026. Six were handed in Q1, leaving roughly 64-68 units from that backlog plus whatever is sold new during the year. AGAINST WHAT THE BULL BRANCH REQUIRES: dossiers/KDH.md puts it at ~178-186 units handed in FY2026. So the bull case needs roughly TWO AND A HALF TIMES the entire opening Gladia backlog, to be sourced from sales not yet made. That is a TIGHTER constraint than the 135-unit sold-book argument already on file, and it arrives from a different direction. ON INDEPENDENCE, AND I AM BEING CAREFUL ABOUT THIS TODAY. This morning I collapsed three routes that were really one, so the claim here is bounded: the sold-book route counts UNITS from 226 x 60%; this route counts VALUE from a Vietcap backlog estimate. Different source, different measure, different unit of account - but they describe overlapping inventory, so they are CORROBORATING rather than strictly independent. Both are bounded by the same physical project. THE LIMITS, stated rather than buried: single source; ASP-dependent, and the ASP itself is unresolved between 42 and 44 (OPEN-DECISIONS item 15); and BACKLOG IS NOT THE SOLD BOOK - backlog is contracted revenue not yet recognised, while the sold book is cumulative contracts including units already handed. The two are related but not the same quantity. NOTHING CHANGED. actuals._Q2_FILED_2026_07_30: KDH Q2/2026 IS FILED AND IT IS A LARGE MISS AGAINST EVERY STREET ESTIMATE. RE-WEIGHTING PROBABILITIES IS A JUDGMENT CHANGE RESERVED FOR A HUMAN UNDER CHARTER SECTION 2 AND IS NOT DONE HERE. Escalated instead. actuals._770BN_REJECTION_WAS_TOO_STRONG_2026_07_: CORRECTION TO MY OWN ENTRY FROM ONE HOUR AGO. At 17:53 I wrote that the reported Q2 net profit of ~770bn was 'internally impossible' and rejected it. THAT WAS OVERSTATED. It is irreconcilable with H1 net profit of 321bn ON A SINGLE MEASURE BASIS - but the two figures may simply be on DIFFERENT BASES, and that possibility is not eliminated. THE RECONCILING READING, which I cannot rule out: 'loi nhuan sau thue' (total NPAT, including minority interests) of ~770bn in Q2, against 'lai rong' (NPAT attributable to parent) of 321bn for H1. KDH FULLY CONSOLIDATES JVs IT DOES NOT WHOLLY OWN - the file records a 51% Gladia stake - so minority interests are material. Q1 parent ~327 and H1 parent 321 gives Q2 PARENT of about -6bn, which is CONSISTENT with a Q2 TOTAL of +770bn if roughly 776bn accrued to minorities. That is a large minority share, and it is unusual, but a deconsolidation can produce exactly that shape. SO THE HONEST STATUS IS: EITHER ONE FIGURE IS WRONG OR THEY ARE DIFFERENT MEASURES. Not resolved. The separate statement will settle it. What I should have written an hour ago is that the two do not reconcile on one basis - not that one of them is impossible. THIS IS THE SAME ERROR SHAPE AS THIS MORNING'S q1_revenue MISTAKE, twelve hours apart: treating an apparent contradiction as settled when a MEASURE DIFFERENCE could explain it. There I forced two numbers to be the same thing; here I forced them to be incompatible. Both are the same failure to hold 'these may be different quantities' open. WHAT IS NEW AND NOT IN DOUBT, and it strengthens rather than weakens the thesis: THE PROFIT IS ONE-OFF DRIVEN, NOT OPERATIONAL. Press covering the filing states that most of KDH's H1 profit came from ONE-TIME INCOME rather than from selling and handing over property. The Q2 item named is the disposal of a 2% interest in BINH TRUNG MOI REAL ESTATE on 23-JUN-2026 for over 68bn. Q1's was the 285bn An Lap bargain-purchase gain. TWO CONSECUTIVE QUARTERS WHERE THE HEADLINE PROFIT COMES FROM TRANSACTIONS RATHER THAN FROM THE BUSINESS, while revenue fell 75% across the half. NOTE the 68bn disposal cannot by itself explain a 770bn profit swing, which is a further reason the 770bn figure needs the statement rather than the press.
actuals._ASP_THE_LISTING_SITE_ROUTE_FAILS_AND_IS: OPEN-DECISIONS ITEM 15 (ASP 42 vs 44bn) WAS ATTEMPTED VIA PROJECT PRICE PAGES AND THE ROUTE FAILS. RECORDED AS A DISARMED TRAP RATHER THAN AS EVIDENCE, because the numbers it returns are attractive, easy to find, and would badly corrupt a load-bearing input. WHAT THE ROUTE RETURNS: broker and agency pages quoting Gladia at '15 ty/can' (June 2026) and low-rise product 'from 230 trieu/m2' (July 2026). WHY NEITHER IS USABLE. (1) SOURCE: these are AGENCY MARKETING PAGES, not company disclosure - below T6 on the charter's ladder, and written by parties whose incentive is to quote an attractive entry price. Charter s2 permits T6 to raise confidence not at all; this is weaker still. (2) MEASURE: '15 ty/can' is a headline or STARTING price for the cheapest product, not a realised ASP across a handover mix. (3) THE TWO QUOTES CONTRADICT EACH OTHER: at 230m/m2, a 250-300m2 villa is 57-69bn, four times the same site's own '15 ty/can'. A source that disagrees with itself by 4x cannot settle a 4.8% question. AND THE FILE'S OWN ARITHMETIC ALREADY REFUTES THE 15bn. Q1 revenue of ~252-264bn on 6 UNITS HANDED gives 42-44bn per unit directly, which is where the on-file figure comes from. If ASP were 15bn, six handovers would have produced ~90bn, not ~252-264bn. THE INTERNAL CHECK KILLS IT WITHOUT NEEDING AN EXTERNAL SOURCE, which is the cheapest kind of refutation and the one to reach for first. WHAT LOGGING IT WOULD HAVE COST: ASP is the denominator that converts KDH revenue into UNIT COUNTS, and the unit count is the whole basis of the dossier's bull-infeasibility finding (bull needs ~178-186 units against a 135-unit sold book). Substituting 15bn would have inflated implied unit counts by ~2.9x and made the bull case look impossible FOR A FABRICATED REASON - a right conclusion reached through a wrong number, which the calibration log already records as a failure mode. ITEM 15 STAYS OPEN. It is settled by the segment note in KDH's own financial statements - revenue by project divided by units delivered - not by any price list. SAME SPECIES AS THE HRC BENCHMARK TRAP: right name, wrong basis, and the wrong one is the one a search finds first.
actuals._ESCALATION_TRIGGER_5_VNDIAMOND_EFFECTIV: ESCALATION - TRIGGER 5 FIRES. DECISION-FRAMEWORK s4 test 5 is 'a dated catalyst lands within 5 sessions of a proposed trade in that name'. KDH carries a proposed TRIM of -4.7pp and is 20.3% of the book. THE VNDIAMOND REVIEW RESULTS WERE ANNOUNCED 20-JULY-2026 AND THE CHANGES TAKE EFFECT 03-AUGUST-2026, WHICH IS MONDAY - THE NEXT TRADING SESSION. WHY KDH IS EXPOSED: it was placed on the removal watch list for failing VNDiamond's MINIMUM FOREIGN OWNERSHIP LIMIT TEST OF 65%, SITTING AT 61.8%, and the decisive review is the SEMI-ANNUAL one held in JULY - which CORRECTS what this file wrote at 19:53. That entry said 'reviews are quarterly, so a Q3 review falls around July'. The timing was right by accident; the mechanism was not. VNDIAMOND REBALANCES QUARTERLY BUT REVIEWS CONSTITUENTS SEMI-ANNUALLY, and removal happens at the semi-annual review. Sources state KDH 'may be officially removed at the next semi-annual review in July 2026 if there is no improvement above the 65% mark'. WHETHER IT WAS ACTUALLY REMOVED IS STILL NOT ESTABLISHED. The 20-July announcement itself was not found this sweep. THAT IS THE WHOLE QUESTION AND IT IS NOT GUESSED. AND THE FLOW HAS PROBABLY ALREADY HAPPENED, WHICH CHANGES WHAT THE HUMAN SHOULD BE ASKING. On 31-JUL this file established, and corrected its own escalation over, the mechanic that INDEX FUNDS TRADE AT THE CLOSE OF THE SESSION BEFORE AN EFFECTIVE DATE, NOT ON IT - that is why the VN30 ETFs completed their rebalance on 31-Jul for a 03-Aug effective date. THE SAME MECHANIC APPLIES HERE. If KDH was removed on 20-Jul, the ETF selling would have completed AT FRIDAY 31-JULY'S CLOSE, and Monday's effective date is administrative. SO THE QUESTION IS NOT 'WHAT HAPPENS MONDAY', IT IS 'DID IT ALREADY HAPPEN ON FRIDAY, AND DOES THE FILE'S KDH PRICE REFLECT IT'. That runs straight into OPEN-DECISIONS item 2: prices are undated and presumed 24-Jul. Friday 31-Jul saw VN-Index -8.9 points, foreign net selling of 307bn and roughly 200 decliners - THIS FILE DOES NOT KNOW WHETHER KDH WAS AMONG THEM. SIZE, WITH THE GAP STATED: KDH's VNDiamond weight is NOT KNOWN, so the removal flow cannot be sized against the ~12,486bn tracking pool. TCB's 9.0% weight is ~1,124bn for scale. NOTHING MODELLED, no weight, branch or probability touched. ALSO CONFIRMED, and it shows the door swings both ways: MWG RETURNED to VNDiamond after half a year out, so removal is not permanent.
actuals._THE_VNDIAMOND_FLOW_IS_SIZED_AND_MY_OWN_: SIZED, AND THE FIRST THING TO SAY IS THAT MY OWN ILLUSTRATIONS TWO SWEEPS AGO WERE BADLY TOO HIGH. At 19:53, unable to find KDH's index weight, this file offered '3/5/7% would be 375/624/874bn of forced selling' and labelled them illustrations rather than estimates. THE ACTUAL FIGURE IS ABOUT 72bn - BETWEEN FIVE AND TWELVE TIMES SMALLER THAN THE RANGE ILLUSTRATED. The label was correct and the numbers were still misleading, because a reader takes the magnitude from the digits and not from the caveat. OFFERING AN ILLUSTRATIVE RANGE WHEN THE REAL NUMBER IS UNKNOWN ANCHORS THE READER AT WHATEVER THE ILLUSTRATION HAPPENS TO BE. Better to have written 'weight unknown, cannot be sized' and stopped. THE FIGURE: ETFs are expected to sell OVER 4 MILLION KDH SHARES to remove it from the portfolio. At the file's 18,000 price that is ~72bn, which is 0.40% OF KDH'S ~18,010bn IMPLIED MARKET CAP. For comparison the TCX VN30 entry was 59bn on an 82,215bn cap, or 0.073% - so IN RELATIVE TERMS KDH'S REMOVAL IS ABOUT 5.5x THE TCX EVENT, and in absolute terms the two are similar. KDH is named among the largest selling pressures alongside NLG AND MSB. AND THE CAUSE CLOSES A LOOP THIS FILE HAD BOTH HALVES OF. The sources are explicit that KDH DID NOT CHANGE ITS FOREIGN OWNERSHIP LIMIT - the adjusted FOL fell because FOREIGN INVESTORS REDUCED THEIR HOLDINGS OVER THE PAST TWELVE MONTHS. This file recorded on 30-Jul that VINACAPITAL HAS BEEN SELLING KDH DOWN THROUGH THE 7% THRESHOLD to 6.9621%, and treated that as an ownership signal pointing the opposite way to the insider buy. IT IS ALSO A MECHANICAL CAUSE: foreign selling lowers the FOL ratio, a low FOL ratio triggers index removal, and index removal forces further selling. STATED PROPORTIONATELY - VinaCapital's disclosed steps are April-May and the FOL decline is described over twelve months, so VinaCapital is ONE CONTRIBUTOR, NOT THE CAUSE. The loop is real; the attribution is partial. STILL NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the 20-July announcement actually removed KDH. The '4 million shares' is a FORECAST of ETF selling, and search returns keep mixing the Q2 review (cutoff 31-Mar, announced 20-Apr, effective 04-May) with the July one (announced 20-Jul, effective 03-Aug). The two follow the same announce-then-effective-two-weeks-later pattern, WHICH IS EXACTLY WHY THEY ARE EASY TO CONFLATE. The trigger-5 escalation stands on the date, not on a confirmed removal.
actuals._KDH_ABSENT_FROM_FRIDAYS_SELL_LIST_AND_W: LOOKED FOR THE FOOTPRINT OF THE VNDIAMOND REMOVAL INSTEAD OF THE ANNOUNCEMENT, AFTER THREE FAILED ATTEMPTS AT THE ANNOUNCEMENT ITSELF. KDH DOES NOT APPEAR AMONG THE LARGEST FOREIGN NET SELLS ON 31-JUL; that list is VHM, TCB, VPB, NVL and ACB. AND I WAS PROBABLY LOOKING IN THE WRONG COLUMN, WHICH IS THE USEFUL PART. THE VNDIAMOND ETFs ARE DOMESTIC FUNDS - DCVFMVN Diamond (Dragon Capital), MAFM, KIM Growth, VFCVN (TPBank). Their rebalancing trades are DOMESTIC INSTITUTIONAL FLOW and need not appear in the FOREIGN net-sell column at all. The picture is genuinely ambiguous, because foreign investors are the main HOLDERS of these ETFs - that is their purpose, accessing FOL-capped stocks - so redemptions could surface as foreign flow. EITHER WAY, ABSENCE FROM A FOREIGN TOP-FIVE IS WEAK EVIDENCE ABOUT A DOMESTIC ETF REBALANCE. SIZE ALSO ARGUES FOR CAUTION: the estimated removal flow is ~72bn against VHM's 249bn on the HOSE measure, so KDH could have been sold in full and still missed a top-five list. THE HONEST CONCLUSION IS THAT THIS SWEEP DID NOT ANSWER THE QUESTION, and the negative result is recorded so the next sweep does not spend budget re-running it. THE ANSWER NEEDS EITHER THE 20-JULY HOSE ANNOUNCEMENT OR KDH'S TRADING-VOLUME SERIES FOR 31-JUL, NEITHER OF WHICH THIS ENVIRONMENT HAS REACHED. ONE FIGURE CONFIRMED IN PASSING: KDH's 2026 AGM profit target of 1,500bn matches company_plan_npat already on file exactly, alongside 'clean of bond debt' and an explicit commitment to NO NEW EQUITY ISSUANCE. The last of those is worth having beside the VNDiamond problem - a company that has ruled out issuing equity has one fewer lever for raising its foreign-ownership ratio.

actuals._A_THIRD_Q2_PROFIT_FIGURE_AND_IT_REOPENS: MATERIAL CONFLICT ON 20.3% OF THE BOOK, FLAGGED AND DELIBERATELY NOT RESOLVED. A source states KDH RECORDED NEARLY 750bn OF NET PROFIT IN Q2/2026 'despite reduced real-estate transfer revenue'. THE FILE HOLDS Q1 NPAT 327 AND H1 NPAT 321, WHICH MAKES Q2 APPROXIMATELY MINUS SIX - the 'Q2 profit is roughly zero' finding that scored calibration forecast #1 a MISS and drove the 'branches contradicted from above' escalation. THERE ARE NOW THREE Q2 FIGURES IN CIRCULATION: ~0 (derived here), ~750bn (this sweep), and 770bn (seen 30-JUL). THE LAST TWO ARE 2.6% APART, close enough to be one underlying number reported twice with different rounding or scope. AND THAT REOPENS SOMETHING I WITHDREW ONLY PARTLY. On 30-Jul I called a reported 770bn Q2 profit 'INTERNALLY IMPOSSIBLE' against H1 of 321, then self-corrected to 'irreconcilable ON ONE MEASURE BASIS, but total NPAT versus parent NPAT would reconcile it'. THAT WITHDRAWAL WAS TOO NARROW. A second source near the same figure means the number is probably real and the reconciliation is probably the measure, not an error in the press. The correction I made was right in form and under-done in force. THE MOST LIKELY RECONCILIATIONS, STATED AS HYPOTHESES AND NOT ADOPTED: (a) 321 is PARENT/ATTRIBUTABLE while 750-770 is TOTAL CONSOLIDATED - KDH fully consolidates JVs it part-owns, which this file established during the Gladia error; or (b) the larger figure includes a DIVESTMENT GAIN that the 321 excludes. A separate report describes KDH 'setting a profit record on a divestment'. NOTE THE TENSION: a Q3 completion should not produce a Q2 gain, so if 750bn is a Q2 figure the divestment is NOT the explanation - which is exactly why this is flagged rather than resolved. STRUCTURE THE FILE DID NOT HAVE: CLARITA AND EMERIA ARE THE TWO KEPPEL JV LAND FUNDS THAT COMBINED TO FORM GLADIA BY THE WATER. Keppel 49% / KDH 51%, agreed May-2023, both in Thu Duc, construction from Oct-2023. 'Clarita divestment' is a named lane-3 item and every prior hit on Clarita in this repo was MY OWN MENTION FROM THIS WEEKEND, not research. THIS IS THE THIRD MULTI-SOURCE NUMERIC CONFLICT ON KDH IN TEN DAYS - q1_revenue (281.4, three sweeps to resolve), the 770bn Q2 figure, and now this. KDH IS THE SINGLE LARGEST SOURCE OF NUMERIC AMBIGUITY IN THE BOOK, and it is the second-largest position with a live trigger-5 escalation. NOTHING CHANGED: no actual overwritten, no branch, probability or confidence touched. The resolving document is KDH's Q2 financial statement showing the parent-versus-consolidated split and the treatment of any divestment gain.
actuals._ESCALATION_THE_H1_NPAT_ON_FILE_IS_WRONG: ESCALATION. h1_npat = 321 IS WRONG AS A CONSOLIDATED FIGURE, AND THE ERROR PROPAGATED INTO A SCORED CALIBRATION ENTRY AND AN ESCALATION. THE DRIVER IS FINANCIAL INCOME OF MORE THAN 906bn, arising largely from THE TRANSFER OF 51% OF BINH TRUNG MOI - and core property operations did collapse, which is why one source reads 'core business plunges, KDH still reports profit up four times'. BOTH HALVES ARE TRUE AND THIS FILE ONLY EVER HAD ONE. WHAT THIS CORRECTS, IN ORDER OF SEVERITY. (1) The 30-Jul entry derived 'Q2 PROFIT IS APPROXIMATELY ZERO' from H1 321 minus Q1 327. THAT DERIVATION IS WRONG BECAUSE ITS INPUT WAS WRONG. (2) The same entry called a reported 770bn Q2 profit 'INTERNALLY IMPOSSIBLE'. IT IS THE CORRECT FIGURE. WHY THIS IS THE SHARPEST KDH FINDING SINCE THE Q2 PRINT. run.py section 2 calls this name 'the whole 2026 P&L is one variable' and the variable is the Gladia handover. THE LARGEST COMMERCIAL EVENT OF KDH'S YEAR HAS JUST BEEN PLACED, BY THE DEVELOPER, OUTSIDE THE YEAR THE MODEL IS ABOUT.

THE H2 ARITHMETIC, WHICH STANDS WHATEVER THE BRANCHES ASSUME. H1/2026 consolidated NPAT is 1,097bn. AGAINST fy26e_npat: BASE 1,590 NEEDS 493bn MORE IN H2; BULL 2,203 NEEDS 1,106bn. AND A THING WORTH SAYING PLAINLY: BEAR IS 1,033, WHICH H1 HAS ALREADY EXCEEDED BY 64bn - THE BEAR BRANCH IS UNREACHABLE FROM HERE ABSENT A WRITE-DOWN, and that is a consequence of the Binh Trung Moi deconsolidation gain rather than of trading. SO H2 MUST DELIVER 493-1,106bn, AND THE ONLY 4,000bn COMMERCIAL EVENT OF THE YEAR IS EXPLICITLY RING-FENCED TO 2027. That is a statement about the GAP, not about the branches, and it holds either way.

WHAT I CANNOT ESTABLISH, AND THEREFORE DO NOT ACT ON. WHETHER fy26e_npat EVER INCLUDED GLADIA HEIGHTS. The dossier's unit economics are built on LOW-RISE product at 42-44bn per unit; Gladia Heights is APARTMENTS. If the branches were always about low-rise handovers, this news changes nothing about them and merely confirms an assumption never written down. If they implicitly leaned on the Gladia complex as a whole, it is materially adverse. CONFIDENCE IS NOT MOVED, FIFTH APPLICATION OF THE SAME RULE THIS WEEK: I would be cutting a scalar on an inference about what the branches contain, and this file has refused that in both directions - it declined to RAISE on circular_25's favourable environment and declined to CUT on TCX's multiple. THE KILL CRITERION IS NOW LIVE. It reads 'customer advances < 1,000bn at 3Q26 WITH GLADIA HEIGHTS LAUNCHED' and is described in the brief as 'the decisive test'. GLADIA HEIGHTS IS LAUNCHED. The test becomes evaluable at the Q3 filing, due about 30-OCT. DIRECTIONALLY IT NOW LOOKS LIKELY TO BE CLEARED: customer advances were 688.6bn at Q1 and roughly 4,000bn of bookings landed on 01-Aug. TWO THINGS STOP THAT BEING A CONCLUSION. (1) BOOKINGS ARE NOT CONTRACTS AND CONTRACTS ARE NOT CASH; a launch-day booking rate of 90% at an event is a marketing figure until deposits appear on a balance sheet. (2) THE CONSOLIDATION BASIS IS NOT DEFINED IN THE CRITERION. Gladia by the Waters is a KEPPEL 49% / KDH 51% JV, so a 51% subsidiary consolidates in FULL with a 49% minority interest - which means customer advances would appear at 100% on KDH's balance sheet while PROFIT is struck after NCI. SO THE ADVANCES TEST AND THE PROFIT LINE SIT ON DIFFERENT ECONOMIC BASES, AND THE CRITERION SAYS NEITHER. THIRD ARMED CRITERION FOUND THIS WEEK WITH AN UNDEFINED SUBJECT, after TCB's 'Masterise bond event' and VPX's gross-versus-net FVTPL test. Human-only under charter s4.

A NEW ASP REGIME THE UNIT ECONOMICS DO NOT CONTAIN. 4,000bn across roughly 450 booked units is ABOUT 8.9bn PER UNIT. ANY 'UNITS HANDED OVER' COUNT FROM Q4/2026 ONWARD WILL MIX TWO PRODUCTS WHOSE PER-UNIT ECONOMICS ARE NOT COMPARABLE, and the bear branch's '80 units for the year' is denominated in the expensive kind. A unit count is no longer a sufficient statistic for this model.

TCLIFE. Licensed by the MINISTRY OF FINANCE ON 16-JULY-2025. CHARTER CAPITAL 1,300bn. TECHCOMBANK CONTRIBUTES 1,040bn FOR 80%. THE REMAINING 20% - 260bn - IS HELD BY VINGROUP COMPANIES. Projected to deliver 1,195bn OF NET PROFIT TO TECHCOMBANK AFTER FIVE YEARS AT A 23.4% RETURN RATE - about 3.2% of an annualised TCB PBT run-rate.

WHY THIS IS DIFFERENT FROM EVERYTHING ELSE IN THE TCB FILE. Every prior ecosystem finding here has been COMMERCIAL AND INFERRED - bond arranging, registrar roles, loan-book composition, the 44,500bn issuance ramp - and each was correctly refused as unproven. AND NOW THE THREE THINGS IT DOES NOT SHOW, WHICH MATTER MORE THAN THE THING IT DOES. (1) IT DOES NOT ESTABLISH CREDIT EXPOSURE. A 20% minority in a 1,300bn insurer is 260bn - trivial against TCB's balance sheet - and a shared shareholding says nothing about lending. THE STANDING REFUSAL ON TCB'S CREDIT EXPOSURE IS UNCHANGED. (2) IT DOES NOT TOUCH THE MASTERISE KILL CRITERION. TCB's armed test says 'a MASTERISE bond event'. VINGROUP AND MASTERISE ARE SEPARATE GROUPS - SBV's Cong van 5386, logged at 05:53 THIS MORNING, NAMES ALL THREE SEPARATELY: Vingroup, Sun Group, Masterise. CONFLATING THEM IS THE EXACT ERROR THIS FILE HAS REFUSED TWICE, AND IT IS REFUSED AGAIN HERE. A Vingroup link is not a Masterise link. (3) IT IS NOT SIZED AS A RISK. 260bn of somebody else's money in an insurance subsidiary is a governance datum, not an exposure.

THE SECOND HALF OF THE STRUCTURE, AND IT IS A CONTROL ACQUISITION. TECHCOMBANK IS RAISING ITS STAKE IN TCGINS, THE NON-LIFE INSURER, FROM 11% TO 68% - A 57-POINT STEP FROM MINORITY TO CONTROL. model._PROVISIONING_IS_FLATTERING_REPORTED_PBT: USER-DIRECTED LINE OF ENQUIRY: 'pay attention to provision for banks and LLR because they might be managing earnings... what is deceptively shown in P&L'. IT IS THERE, IT IS MEASURABLE, AND IT IS LARGE. METHOD: pre-provision operating profit (PPOP) = PBT + credit provisions. PPOP is the OPERATING line; PBT is what the headline reports. Where PBT grows faster than PPOP, the difference is provisioning, not business. TCB (35.0% of the book): H1/2026 PBT 18,540bn +22.5%, CREDIT PROVISIONS 1,587bn, DOWN 24.6%. PPOP 20,127 vs 17,239 = +16.7%. Provisions as a share of PPOP fell 12.2% -> 7.9%, a 4.3pp drop. HAD TCB HELD PROVISIONING INTENSITY AT LAST YEAR'S LEVEL, PBT WOULD HAVE GROWN 16.7%, NOT 22.5% - SO 5.8pp OF THE 22.5pp IS LOWER PROVISIONING. AND THE FORWARD INDICATOR IS MOVING THE OTHER WAY: GROUP 2 (SPECIAL MENTION) LOANS ROSE 46% AND THE CORPORATE BOND BOOK ROSE 80%. Group 2 is the pipeline into NPLs. Provisions falling 24.6% while the pipeline grows 46% is the exact pattern the question asks about. MBB (6.5%): H1/2026 PBT 20,188bn +27.1%, provisions 7,701.9bn, DOWN 0.9% - essentially FLAT while the book grew. PPOP 27,890 vs 23,655 = +17.9%. Provisions/PPOP fell 32.9% -> 27.6%, a 5.2pp drop. AT LAST YEAR'S INTENSITY PBT WOULD HAVE GROWN 17.9%, SO 9.2pp OF THE 27.1pp IS PROVISIONING. AND MBB'S OWN NPL BALANCE (GROUP 3-5) ROSE 27% TO 17,800bn WHILE CUSTOMER LOANS ROSE 13.2% - BAD DEBT GREW AT TWICE THE PACE OF THE BOOK, AND PROVISIONS DID NOT MOVE. WHY THE HEADLINE RATIOS DO NOT SHOW IT - THIS IS THE DECEPTIVE PART. MBB's NPL RATIO is 1.45%, barely changed, and COVERAGE ROSE 92.24% -> 93.63%. Both look reassuring. But the NPL ratio has loans in the DENOMINATOR and loans grew 13.2%, so a 27% rise in bad debt shows up as a 3bp rise in the ratio. THE RATIO IS FLATTERED BY GROWTH, WHICH THIS FILE ALREADY NOTED ON 31-JUL AND HAD NOT CONNECTED TO THE PROVISIONING LINE. Coverage rising slightly while the NPL balance rises 27% means the reserve grew too - so the balance sheet was topped up while the P&L CHARGE stayed flat. THAT COMBINATION IS ONLY POSSIBLE THROUGH RECOVERIES, WRITE-BACKS, OR USING EXISTING RESERVE - and none of those are repeatable revenue. A METHOD CHECK THAT PASSED, WORTH RECORDING. Before finding MBB's reported provisioning line I DERIVED it from figures already on file as TOI - opex - PBT = 37,865 - 9,974 - 20,188 = 7,703bn. The reported figure is 7,701.9bn. AGREEMENT TO 0.01%. The derivation is sound, which means THIS ANALYSIS CAN BE RUN ON ANY BANK FOR WHICH TOI, OPEX AND PBT ARE ON FILE, WITHOUT WAITING FOR A PROVISIONING HEADLINE. SECTOR CONTEXT, NOT HELD: VIETCOMBANK'S Q2 PBT ROSE 57.9% WITH PROVISIONS DOWN NEARLY 38%. So this is not a one- or two-bank phenomenon; it is how the sector's 2026 profit growth is being produced. That matters for the read-across discipline this file adopted on 31-Jul: the shared MECHANISM here is a falling credit charge against a rising Group 2 / NPL balance, and it is now NAMED rather than assumed. THE GAP, STATED PLAINLY: VPB (10.0%) GREW PBT 68% AND ITS PROVISIONING LINE IS NOT ESTABLISHED. That is the largest unexplained profit jump in the book and the one name where this analysis could not be run. IT IS THE NEXT CHECK. APPLIED: confidence TCB 0.80 -> 0.70 and MBB 0.55 -> 0.50. NOT because the businesses got worse, but because REPORTED PBT IS A LOWER-QUALITY MEASURE OF EARNINGS POWER THAN THE FILE HAD ASSUMED, on both names, by a quantified amount. This is exactly what the confidence scalar is for - it multiplies fy26e_npat, and fy26e_npat is anchored to reported profit that is 5.8pp (TCB) and 9.2pp (MBB) flattered. fy26e_npat, exit_pe and probs are UNTOUCHED - re-deriving branches onto a PPOP basis is human-only under charter section 4, AND IT IS NOW THE MOST VALUABLE HUMAN TASK IN THE REPO.

This matters doubly because TCBS - held as TCX at 5.5% direct and ~12.2% look-through - is a major bond arranger and distributor, so paper leaving the bank could be landing with TCBS's retail customers, which is a conduct and reputational exposure as well as a credit one. WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT, three specific tests: (1) does TCBS appear as arranger/underwriter/distributor on Masterise-complex issues - readable from HNX issuance disclosures; (2) what corporate bonds does TCB hold on its OWN book - the AR loan-book note, depth-queue item 2, currently blocked on PDF access; (3) does the TIMING of the 44,500bn line up with the quarters in which the loan reduction happened. None of the three has been run. The proximity of two numbers is suggestive and is not evidence. KILL CRITERION: the armed test is 'developer/related-party NPL formation > 2.0%, OR a Masterise bond event'. A VND 44,500bn issuance ramp in six months RAISES THE BASE RATE for such an event without triggering it - more paper outstanding, more refinancing dates, more ways to have one. CONFIDENCE HELD at 0.85, deliberately and for the same reason MBB's was held at 0.55 this morning: confidence measures the quality of the EARNINGS evidence, which here is a filed Q2 and is untouched. What changed is the reading of a governance point and the proximity of a kill criterion. Cutting a confidence weight on an unproven hypothesis would put doubt in the wrong field.

actuals._CREDIT_INPUTS_FAIL_VERIFICATION_2026_07: ESCALATION. The two credit fields in this block cannot both describe the same thing, and which one is right decides whether VPB's forward scenarios are comfortable or very hard. ARITHMETIC: credit_q2 1,060,000 against credit_start_fy 962,000 is +10.19%, NOT the +24.6% recorded in credit_growth_ytd. One of the two is on a different basis. WHAT THE PRESS ACTUALLY SAYS, and it is two different statements: (a) CONSOLIDATED credit reached ~1.06 quadrillion in Q1/26, +10.2% on end-2025 - which reproduces credit_start_fy 962,000 exactly; (b) PARENT-BANK credit reached ~1.06 quadrillion after SIX months, +24.6%. So the likely defect is that credit_q2 is the Q1 CONSOLIDATED figure while credit_growth_ytd is the H1 PARENT figure - a PERIOD error and an ENTITY error, checks 1 and 2 of charter section 3, sitting side by side in one actuals block as though they described one quarter of one entity. LOGICAL CROSS-CHECK: consolidated credit is by construction >= parent credit. If parent was ~1.06 quadrillion at H1, consolidated at H1 must EXCEED 1.06 quadrillion. So credit_q2 = 1,060,000 is too low for consolidated Q2 whichever reading is correct. WHY IT MATTERS: scenarios.credit_growth_fy is 30/35/40%. If H1 consolidated growth was +24.6%, the base branch needs only +8.3% more in H2 and is comfortable. If it was +10.2%, the base branch needs +22.5% in H2 - a step-change of the same character as the KDH handover finding. The company's own FY plan of +34% to 1.29 quadrillion consolidated is consistent with the 962,000 start, so the FY target basis IS consolidated. NOT RESOLVED and NOT GUESSED. The numbers are left exactly as they are; only the flag is added. The consolidated Q2 credit balance is readable directly from the Q2 statement. Confidence cut 0.85 -> 0.70 pending that read.

actuals._THE_250M_PLACEMENT_FIGURE_FAILS_THE_MEA: A MEASURE CHECK ON A NUMBER THAT LIVES IN THE SCHEDULED PROMPT RATHER THAN IN THIS FILE. The hourly routine's lane-3 text carries 'VPB 26% stock dividend + $250m foreign placement'. This file records the placement correctly in its own units - 624m+ shares, charter capital rising 6,243bn to 106,244bn - and carries NO dollar figure, so the two have never been reconciled. THEY DO NOT RECONCILE, AND THE GAP IS ABOUT 2.5x. The charter-capital increase of 6,243bn is the PAR value of the new shares: at FX 26,300 that is ~US$237m, which is close enough to $250m that the prompt's figure is almost certainly the PAR AMOUNT. But 624m shares at VPB's on-file price of 25,000 would raise ~15,600bn, or ~US$593m. actuals._CREDIT_INPUTS_RESOLVED_2026_08_01: OPEN-DECISIONS ITEM 1 - THE TOP BLOCKING ITEM IN THE REPO - IS RESOLVED, AND THE 28-JUL DIAGNOSIS WAS SUBSTANTIALLY RIGHT. THE MISSING NUMBER: CONSOLIDATED CUSTOMER LOANS REACHED ~1,160,000bn AT END-Q2, UP 23% ON END-2025. That is the figure the 28-Jul note said had to exist and could not be found. Its logical cross-check - 'if parent was ~1.06 quadrillion at H1, consolidated at H1 must EXCEED 1.06 quadrillion' - IS CONFIRMED: consolidated exceeds parent by ~100,000bn, which is FE Credit, VPBankS and the rest of the ring. THERE ARE THREE SERIES HERE, NOT TWO, AND THAT IS WHY IT LOOKED IRRECONCILABLE. (1) PARENT BANK CREDIT 1,060,000bn, +24.6% YTD - this is what credit_q2 and credit_growth_ytd BOTH describe, so THOSE TWO FIELDS ARE CONSISTENT WITH EACH OTHER after all. (2) CONSOLIDATED CUSTOMER LOANS 1,160,000bn, +23% YTD, implying an end-2025 base of ~943,089bn. The note was correct that an entity error was present and correct about which figures existed; it attributed the error to the wrong field. AND IT RESOLVES IN VPB'S FAVOUR, WHICH IS THE PART THAT MATTERS. The note framed the stakes: 'if H1 consolidated growth was +24.6%, the base branch needs only +8.3% more in H2 and is comfortable. If it was +10.2%, the base branch needs +22.5% in H2 - a step-change of the same character as the KDH handover finding.' ACTUAL CONSOLIDATED H1 GROWTH IS AT LEAST +20.6% on the 962,000 base, using loans as a lower bound for credit. Against scenarios.credit_growth_fy of 30/35/40%, H2 needs AT MOST +7.8% / +12.0% / +16.1%. THE FEARED STEP-CHANGE IS NOT THERE - the base branch needs ~12%, not 22.5%. It removes a blocking objection to a recommendation rather than moving a number. CONFIDENCE NOT RAISED, and this is a deliberate call against the routine's instruction. actuals._THE_26_PERCENT_LABEL_IS_PINNED_AND_THE_: THE LABEL QUESTION FLAGGED IN _CORPORATE_ACTIONS IS RESOLVED, AND THE REASON IT LOOKED AMBIGUOUS IS MORE INTERESTING THAN THE ANSWER. That note said sources describe the 26% variously as 'co phieu thuong' (bonus shares) and 'co tuc co phieu' (stock dividend), that these are different instruments for tax and accounting even at an identical ratio, and that the label was NOT YET PINNED. THE SEQUENCE, NOW EXPLICIT. (1) 22-APR-2026, AGM: approved issuing shares TO INCREASE CHARTER CAPITAL FROM OWNER'S EQUITY - a bonus issue. (2) JULY 2026, WRITTEN SHAREHOLDER POLL, before 30-Jul: shareholders approved AMENDING that into a plan to ISSUE SHARES TO PAY A DIVIDEND FROM UNDISTRIBUTED ACCUMULATED POST-TAX PROFIT - a stock dividend. (3) 30-JUL-2026, BOARD RESOLUTION: implements it, 2.06bn shares at 26.04%, holders of 10 million shares receive over 2.6 million new ones, Q3-Q4/2026. SO IT IS A STOCK DIVIDEND, AND BOTH DESCRIPTIONS WERE CORRECT AT DIFFERENT TIMES. The conflict was not sloppy reporting; THE INSTRUMENT ITSELF CHANGED IN JULY. GENERAL LESSON WORTH MORE THAN THIS INSTANCE: when two sources give the same event different TECHNICAL labels, check whether the thing changed between them before deciding one source is wrong. This file's habit has been to treat conflicting labels as one of them being an error - here that habit would have discarded a true statement. WHY IT MATTERS, AND IT IS A REAL COST THIS FILE DID NOT HAVE. In Vietnam a STOCK DIVIDEND PAID FROM RETAINED EARNINGS IS A DIVIDEND DISTRIBUTION and attracts 5% personal income tax for individual holders; a BONUS ISSUE FROM OWNER'S EQUITY is a capital restructuring and is not taxed as a dividend at issuance. THE JULY AMENDMENT THEREFORE MOVED 2.06 BILLION SHARES FROM A NON-TAXABLE CAPITAL INCREASE INTO A TAXABLE DISTRIBUTION. cfa.py already carries TAX_DIVIDEND = 0.05 and has never applied it to this event. ORDER OF MAGNITUDE, FLAGGED AS SUCH: on a par-value basis, 0.2604 new shares x 10,000 par x 5% = ~130 VND of tax per share held, which is 0.52% of the 25,000 price on file. NOT A PRECISE NUMBER - the timing (tax is generally collected on disposal) and the base are both matters this file has not verified, and the draft MoF decree carried in cfa.py as TAX_GAINS_DRAFT = 0.20 is explicitly NOT LAW. It is recorded to size the issue, not to model it. AND IT EXPOSES A GAP NEXT TO OPEN-DECISIONS ITEM 3. That item asks for a cash_yield convention. THERE IS NO CONVENTION AT ALL FOR STOCK-DIVIDEND TAX, and three of the eight names have undated stock issues pending - VPB 26%, MBB 15%, TCB 60%. Whichever convention a human sets for cash should be set for stock in the same sitting.

actuals._THE_VPB_PROVISIONING_GAP_IS_CLOSED_AND_: THE STANDING OPEN CHECK FROM 20:53 IS ANSWERED. It was recorded then as 'the largest unexplained profit jump in the book and the one name this analysis could not be run on', and deliberately NOT inferred from peers. THAT REFUSAL WAS CORRECT - VPB BREAKS THE PEER PATTERN IN BOTH DIRECTIONS AT ONCE, AND ANY INFERENCE FROM TCB OR MBB WOULD HAVE BEEN WRONG. THE FILED FIGURES. H1/2026 TOI 43,400bn (+35.2%); CREDIT PROVISIONS 15,579bn, UP 23.7%; PBT 18,900bn (+68%). PPOP = 34,479bn against 23,844bn, so THE OPERATING LINE GREW 44.6%. FIRST WAY IT BREAKS THE PATTERN - PROVISIONS ROSE. TCB cut its charge 24.6% and MBB held flat; VPB INCREASED its charge by 23.7%, nearly 3,000bn more money set aside. On the crude read - 'are they provisioning less?' - VPB is the opposite of its peers. SECOND WAY IT BREAKS THE PATTERN - INTENSITY FELL THE MOST. Provisions as a share of PPOP went 52.8% -> 45.2%, A FALL OF 7.6pp, LARGER THAN TCB'S 4.3pp AND MBB'S 5.3pp. The reported 45.2% matches the derived figure exactly, which is the second validation of this method today (MBB agreed to 0.01%). AT LAST YEAR'S INTENSITY PBT WOULD HAVE GROWN 44.6%, SO 23.4pp OF THE 68pp IS LOWER PROVISIONING INTENSITY - the largest absolute contribution of the three banks. THIRD AND MOST IMPORTANT - THE UNDERLYING BUSINESS IS BY FAR THE STRONGEST. PPOP +44.6% against TCB's +16.7% and MBB's +17.9%. VPB'S GROWTH IS NOT MANUFACTURED THE WAY THE PEERS' PARTLY IS; it is a genuinely faster-growing operating business that ALSO benefited from a falling credit-cost ratio. All three statements are true simultaneously and EACH ONE ALONE WOULD MISLEAD. THE WARNING, AND IT IS THE THIRD INSTANCE OF THE SAME DILUTION TODAY. GROUP 4 - 'DOUBTFUL' DEBT - ROSE FROM 10,880bn TO 15,718bn, UP 44.5%, WHILE THE NPL RATIO FELL FROM 3.33% TO 3.28%. Same mechanism as MBB's: the ratio has loans in the denominator and the book is growing, so a 44.5% deterioration in the second-worst debt category presents as a 5bp IMPROVEMENT. NOTE ALSO THAT VPB'S NPL RATIO IS ALREADY MORE THAN DOUBLE TCB'S AND MBB'S, so this is deterioration from a much weaker base. FE CREDIT, WHICH THIS FILE HAS ARGUED ABOUT BEFORE. Its provisions were 6,158bn against 5,674bn a year earlier (+8.5%) - roughly 40% OF THE ENTIRE GROUP'S PROVISIONING CHARGE - FOR A PROFIT CONTRIBUTION OF 152.6bn. That is consistent with the note already on file that FE Credit is under 1% of consolidated profit, and it SHARPENS it: FE Credit is not merely immaterial to profit, IT CONSUMES ABOUT FORTY PERCENT OF THE CREDIT CHARGE TO PRODUCE THAT IMMATERIAL PROFIT. The run.py line calling FE Credit NPL formation the swing factor (OPEN-DECISIONS item 11) is wrong about profit and closer to right about PROVISIONS. CONFIDENCE HELD AT 0.70, DELIBERATELY, AND THE REASONING IS STATED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. Two effects offset: the evidence base is now the MOST COMPLETE of the three banks (the credit pair resolved 01-Aug, the provisioning line resolved now), which argues up; and reported PBT is 23.4pp flattered with group-4 debt up 44.5%, which argues down. DECIDING WHICH DOMINATES IS A JUDGMENT ABOUT THE BRANCHES, WHICH IS EXACTLY WHAT OPEN-DECISIONS ITEM 26 IS FOR. Moving a scalar would substitute for that work rather than do it. NOTHING ELSE MODELLED. SEPARATELY NOTED, NOT PURSUED: VPB has put 1,100bn into a TOKENISED-ASSET EXCHANGE. That touches the CAEX crypto-licence option carried on VPX (caex_option, p=0.40 of a licence ~Q3). Whether this is the same venture is NOT established and is not assumed.

actuals._THE_FLOW_HAPPENED_TODAY_NOT_MONDAY_2026: CORRECTION TO AN ESCALATION THIS FILE RAISED THREE HOURS AGO. At 15:53 today I escalated trigger 5 with the words 'TCX joins VN30 on MONDAY 3 AUGUST. Today is the last session before it.' TWO INDEPENDENT SOURCES THIS SWEEP: the ETFs tracking VN30 COMPLETE THEIR PORTFOLIO RESTRUCTURING ON 31-JULY-2026, ahead of the new basket's EFFECTIVE date of 03-AUG-2026. Anyone reading my 15:53 wording would have expected the flow on Monday and would have been a session late. AN EFFECTIVE DATE IS NOT A FLOW DATE. Same species as everything else caught this week: two different quantities sharing one label. The date gate has carried '3-Aug' since 26-Jul and it was never wrong about the index; it was silently wrong about WHEN THE MONEY MOVES, because nobody asked. TRIGGER 5 IS THEREFORE RESOLVED, NOT PENDING. The catalyst has landed. No trade was proposed as executed and none was placed - the escalation existed to put the date in front of a human before it passed, and what it should have said is that the date had effectively already passed. THE SIZING ON FILE IS CONFIRMED AGAIN AND BY A THIRD PARTY'S OWN FRAMING. ACBS: TCX 1.3m shares, 59bn; this file carries ~60bn and 0.073% of market cap. actuals._THE_EXACT_WEIGHTS_THE_28_JUL_NOTE_SAID_: THE 28-JUL NOTE SAID 'WHY IT MATTERS EVEN WITHOUT THE EXACT WEIGHTS'. THE EXACT WEIGHTS ARE NOW IN HAND AND THEY ARE MORE DECISIVE THAN THAT NOTE COULD ASSUME. FTSE GEIS inclusion runs in FOUR tranches: 21-SEP-2026 AT 10% OF INVESTABILITY WEIGHT, then March 2027 at 20%, June 2027 at 35% and September 2027 at 35%. Cumulatively 10 / 30 / 65 / 100. SO THE DAY THE EVENT TREE PRICES DELIVERS ONE TENTH OF THE INCLUSION. ftse_event_tree prices 21-Sep as one discrete event at +20% (p=0.35) / +5% (p=0.45) / -15% (p=0.20), EV +6.25%. NINETY PERCENT OF THE INCLUSION FLOW ARRIVES ACROSS THREE 2027 DATES - all of them AFTER forecast #7 resolves on ~21-OCT-2026. SIZED AGAINST THE INDEX. Vietnam's projected weight at FULL inclusion is 0.22% of the FTSE Emerging Index and 0.34% of Emerging All Cap. AT THE FIRST TRANCHE THAT IS 0.022% AND 0.034% RESPECTIVELY, SPREAD ACROSS 28 VIETNAMESE STOCKS, of which TCX is one. Also 0.04% of Global All Cap and 0.02% of All-World at full weight. Doing so requires Frontier-tracking AUM with Vietnam exposure against Emerging-tracking AUM applied to a 0.022% day-one weight, and neither figure is on file. STATING A DIRECTION HERE WOULD BE INVENTING ONE. THE 28-JUL COUNTER-ARGUMENT IS PRESERVED AND STILL STANDS: passive money moves mechanically on effective dates, but markets front-run reclassifications, so the price response on the day need not be proportional to the mechanical flow. That cuts both ways here - it is also why a 10% tranche could still move price, and why an already-banked announcement effect could leave the day flat. WHAT THIS ADDS TO OPEN-DECISIONS ITEM 5, which already asks whether to re-weight or retire the tree on three grounds (phasing, not wired into decide.py, four straight years of foreign net selling): A FOURTH AND THE MOST CONCRETE - the tree's magnitudes describe a full reclassification and the date it prices delivers a tenth of one side of it. NOTHING CHANGED: forecast #7 was pre-registered and resolves ~21-Oct; re-weighting it now on evidence about mechanics would be the post-hoc adjustment pre-registration exists to prevent. actuals._THE_CORRECTION_MOVES_A_KILL_CRITERION_F: THIS IS THE CONSEQUENCE OF THE P/B FINDING AND IT IS THE MOST IMPORTANT LINE IN TODAY'S SWEEP. decide.py carries a TCX kill criterion: 'P/B < 2.0x on unchanged earnings = the re-rating case is dead', status armed. actuals._ESCALATION_TRIGGER_3_THE_ENGINE_PRICES_: ESCALATION TRIGGER 3 - EXPECTED RETURN MOVES MORE THAN 10pp. IT MOVES 34.3pp. THIS IS THE LARGEST SINGLE-NAME ERROR FOUND SO FAR AND IT IS IN THE ENGINE, NOT IN THE NARRATIVE. decide.py line 67 computes cap_now = pe_ttm x npat_ttm, and every expected return is (exit_pe x fy26e_npat) / cap_now - 1. For TCX that is 20.3 x 4,050 = 82,215bn. THE ARITHMETIC, ON UNCHANGED BRANCHES AND UNCHANGED PROBS: at cap_now 82,215bn, mu_raw = +23.1%. At the file price, mu_raw = -11.2%. At the verified 24-Jul price, mu_raw = -6.9%. actuals._TCX_IS_THE_COUNTER_EXAMPLE_ITS_EARNINGS: COMPLETES THE EARNINGS-QUALITY SWEEP ACROSS THE BOOK, AND TCX IS THE COUNTER-EXAMPLE. THAT MATTERS: after finding provisioning flattery at TCB, MBB and VPB and an unevaluable FVTPL test at VPX, the risk is concluding that every name is managing earnings. TCX IS NOT. IT IS THE OPPOSITE. Q2/2026: REVENUE 3,745bn UP 41%, PBT 2,097bn UP ONLY 21%. Costs went from 923bn to 1,648bn, UP 78.6% - NEARLY DOUBLE - and the PBT margin fell from 65.2% to 56.0%, a 9.3pp compression. PROFIT GREW AT HALF THE RATE OF REVENUE. Where the banks' reported profit outran their operating line, TCX's lags its own top line. Nothing here is being flattered; if anything the reported number understates the franchise's growth. THE STRIKING LINE, AND IT IS NOT REASSURING. TCBS ARRANGED ~61,000bn OF BOND ISSUANCE IN Q2, UP 138%, of which ~59,000bn was non-bank corporate paper - A 48% MARKET SHARE AND NUMBER ONE IN VIETNAM. YET THE CAPITAL-MARKETS AND BOND-DISTRIBUTION NET INCOME WAS 964bn, UP JUST 7% - THE SLOWEST-GROWING SEGMENT IT HAS. VOLUME UP 138% PRODUCED INCOME UP 7%. Either fee rates compressed severely, or the incremental volume is being arranged at very low margin, or the segment line nets off something not disclosed here. WHICH OF THOSE IS TRUE IS NOT ESTABLISHED AND IS NOT GUESSED - but a franchise adding 138% more volume for 7% more income is not converting share into earnings, and that is a question about the QUALITY OF THE GROWTH rather than the quality of the accounting. AND IT JOINS UP WITH THE 18:53 FINDING, WHICH IS WHY IT IS LOGGED HERE RATHER THAN AS A CURIOSITY. TCBS is registrar and depositary for Masterise-linked paper, confirmed from tcbs.com.vn for lot IHP32602. Masterise-linked issuance in H1 was 44,500bn across six enterprises. Against TCX's ~59,000bn of non-bank corporate paper arranged in Q2 alone, THE MASTERISE EXPOSURE SITS INSIDE THE 964bn SEGMENT THAT IS GROWING AT 7%. So the part of TCX most connected to the property-bond complex is also its weakest-growing line. NOT SIZED: what share of TCBS's arranged volume is Masterise-linked is NOT established. VCI NEEDS NO SEPARATE SEARCH - the file already carries its version: Q2 profit -26% QoQ (251 vs 341) behind a +36% YoY headline, revenue flat, operating cash flow negative and funded by borrowings, prop book -430bn on FPT/MWG/KDH. That is the same lens already applied. SO THE BOOK-WIDE EARNINGS-QUALITY PICTURE IS NOW COMPLETE: THREE BANKS FLATTERED BY FALLING PROVISIONING INTENSITY (TCB 5.8pp, MBB 9.2pp, VPB 23.4pp of their growth), ONE BROKER WITH AN UNEVALUABLE FVTPL TEST (VPX), ONE BROKER WHOSE PROFIT IS SHRINKING BEHIND ITS HEADLINE (VCI), AND ONE WHOSE PROFIT LAGS ITS OWN REVENUE (TCX). KDH's one-off deconsolidation gain and HPG's Q1 divestment gain are already documented. CONFIDENCE NOT MOVED (0.75). The finding is favourable to TCX's accounting and unfavourable to its operating leverage, and those offset; and TCX's live issue remains the multiple and the undated price, not the earnings. Nothing modelled.
actuals._THE_FRANCHISE_TEST_CANNOT_BE_COMPLETED_:
RAN THE TEST NAMED AT 12:53 - 'TCBS's fee franchise does not sit on the balance sheet and cannot show up in ROA; THAT is the test that would actually settle it'. IT CANNOT BE COMPLETED FROM PUBLIC DATA, AND SAYING SO IS THE FIRST RESULT.

THE MEASURE MISMATCH THAT BLOCKS IT. The segment figures disclosed are 'THU NHAP THUAN' - NET income - while the 3,745bn headline is 'TONG DOANH THU', GROSS revenue. Investment banking 837bn (+33%) and treasury-and-bond-distribution 964bn (+7%) ARE NOT SHARES OF 3,745bn AND MUST NOT BE DIVIDED INTO IT. The internal check that proves it: 837 + 964 = 1,801bn, which is 85.9% of PBT of 2,097bn - and margin lending and brokerage would still have to cover ALL operating expense out of the remaining 14%. THE SUM DOES NOT WORK AGAINST EITHER DENOMINATOR, so neither ratio is admissible. NO FEE SHARE OF REVENUE IS COMPUTED. This is the fifth comparison refused for want of a common basis in fourteen hours.

WHAT IS ESTABLISHED WITHOUT THE RATIO, AND IT SUPPORTS TCX. TCBS HAS A REAL FEE FRANCHISE AND VPS ESSENTIALLY HAS NONE. Q2/2026 bond issuance arranged ~61,000bn, +138%, of which NON-BANK CORPORATE ~59,000bn - 96.7% of the total - AT 48% MARKET SHARE. IB net income 837bn, +33%, equal to 39.9% of group PBT. Against that, VPS's growth was interest income +95% to 44% of operating revenue WITH BROKERAGE REVENUE FALLING. SO THE 12:53 ROA COMPARISON IS UNFAIR TO TCBS IN EXACTLY THE DIRECTION FLAGGED - 837bn of IB income requires almost no balance sheet, and ROA charges TCBS for assets that earn a different line. THE 12:53 ENTRY SAID THIS WAS THE UNTESTED DEFENCE. IT IS NOW A PARTLY EVIDENCED ONE, AND IT IS RECORDED AS SUCH RATHER THAN LEFT AS AN OBJECTION I RAISED AND DID NOT ANSWER.

AND IT RELOCATES THE RISK RATHER THAN REMOVING IT, WHICH IS THE PART THAT MATTERS. THE FRANCHISE DEFENDING TCX'S PREMIUM IS A PROPERTY-BOND ORIGINATION FRANCHISE. This file already holds, from 31-Jul and 04-Aug: TCX is tied to 'the ecosystem containing major investors associated with projects like Masterise'; Masterise-linked issuance was 44,500bn in H1/2026; NEW PROPERTY-BOND ISSUE RATES HAVE REPRICED TO 11.5-12%, up ~1pp year-on-year; and VIS Rating puts ~60,000bn of REAL-ESTATE bonds maturing in H2/2026, close to half of all corporate maturities. THE PREMIUM IS DEFENDED BY AN EARNINGS STREAM WHOSE UNDERLYING MARKET THIS FILE HAS SEPARATELY DOCUMENTED AS REPRICING. AND THE INTERNAL EVIDENCE POINTS THE SAME WAY: the TREASURY-AND-BOND-DISTRIBUTION line - the segment most connected to that complex, and the one the 02-Aug entry already identified as 'the 964bn segment growing at 7%' - IS STILL TCBS'S WEAKEST LINE AT +7% while origination grew 138%. ORIGINATING FAST AND DISTRIBUTING SLOWLY IS A DIFFERENT BUSINESS FROM ORIGINATING AND DISTRIBUTING FAST, AND WHERE THE DIFFERENCE ENDS UP IS NOT ESTABLISHED HERE. NOT INFERRED, NAMED.

NEW AND ADVERSE, AND IT IS THE KIND OF THING THE STANDING INSTRUCTION ASKS FOR: A RECORD-PROFIT HEADLINE CONCEALING MARGIN COMPRESSION. Q2/2026 REVENUE +41% TO 3,745bn; Q2/2026 PBT +21% TO 2,097bn, 'THE HIGHEST IN ITS HISTORY'. REVENUE GREW ALMOST TWICE AS FAST AS PROFIT. IMPLIED PRIOR-YEAR QUARTER: revenue 2,656bn, PBT 1,733bn. PBT MARGIN 65.25% -> 55.99%, A FALL OF 9.26 PERCENTAGE POINTS. AND THE PEER COMPARISON INVERTS ON THIS MEASURE: VPS's Q2 PBT MARGIN IS 58.56% AND IS ITS HIGHEST EVER. THE SMALLER, LESS DIVERSIFIED BROKER NOW OUT-EARNS TCBS PER DONG OF REVENUE. BOTH GROWTH RATES COME FROM THE SAME RELEASE, so the margin move is internally consistent and does not depend on comparing two sources. CAVEAT KEPT: 'tong doanh thu' definitions can shift between periods; the +41% and +21% are the company's own year-on-year figures, so the inference is only as good as the consistency of its own reporting basis.

NOTHING MODELLED. Q2/2026 is ALREADY an actual in this file and npat_ttm 5,687 is unchanged - what is new is a DECOMPOSITION of a number the branches were built on, not the number. CONFIDENCE HELD AT 0.75, fourth application of the same rule this week: confidence multiplies fy26e_npat and measures how well evidenced the FORECAST is; a margin decomposition of a filed actual does not make the forecast better or worse evidenced. The branches themselves are where a 9.26pp margin fall belongs, and branch construction is human-only under charter s4. ESCALATED.

actuals._THE_KILL_CRITERION_ON_THIS_NAME_GIVES_O: APPLIED THE EARNINGS-QUALITY LENS TO THE BROKERS, WHICH IS WHERE THE BANK PROVISIONING QUESTION LEADS. For a bank the discretionary line is the credit charge; FOR A BROKER IT IS FVTPL - gains marked on financial assets held at fair value, which flow into profit whether or not anything was sold. VPX carries an ARMED KILL CRITERION on exactly this: 'FVTPL marks > 50% of PBT for a THIRD consecutive quarter'. THE QUARTERLY SEQUENCE, RECONSTRUCTED. Q2/2026 is filed: PBT 2,159bn (4x YoY) and FVTPL GROSS GAINS 1,639bn (2.7x YoY), the largest single line in a total operating revenue of 4,098bn. H1 PBT is 2,673bn and H1 FVTPL 3,461bn, so BY SUBTRACTION Q1/2026 WAS PBT 514bn ON FVTPL GAINS OF 1,822bn.   Q1/2026: FVTPL is 354% of PBT. Q2/2026: 76%. H1: 129%. THAT IS TWO CONSECUTIVE QUARTERS ABOVE THE 50% TEST ON A GROSS READING - and the criterion needs three, so IT HAS NOT FIRED, and whether Q3 would be the third depends on Q4/2025, which is NOT on file. BUT THE TEST IS AMBIGUOUS AND THE TWO READINGS DISAGREE, WHICH IS THE REAL FINDING. This file already carried 'Q2 absorbed a 923bn FVTPL loss and prop still netted >700bn'. That RECONCILES with the new figure and explains it: 1,639 GROSS GAIN minus 923 LOSS = 716 NET, which is the '>700bn' already on record. SO THERE ARE TWO DEFENSIBLE MEASURES OF 'FVTPL MARKS' AND THEY GIVE OPPOSITE ANSWERS: on GROSS gains Q2 is 76% of PBT and the chain of consecutive quarters CONTINUES; on NET it is 33% and THE CHAIN BREAKS AT Q2. The criterion does not say which. THIS IS THE SECOND ARMED CRITERION FOUND TODAY WHOSE SUBJECT IS UNDEFINED, after TCB's 'a Masterise bond event' where the boundary of the Masterise group is not crisp. BOTH ARE DEFINITIONAL PROBLEMS IN LIVE TESTS, NOT DATA PROBLEMS, and both are human-only to fix under charter section 4. A kill criterion that cannot be evaluated is not a safeguard. NOTHING IS DECLARED FIRED. AND THE FRANCHISE POINT IS NOW SHARPER THAN THE FILE HAD IT. Q2 BROKERAGE REVENUE WAS 126bn OF 4,098bn - 3.1% OF REVENUE. The dossier already said VPX is 'NOT primarily a broker'; the number is starker than that phrasing suggests. Margin lending and FVTPL are the business; broking is a rounding error. The bond book is now put at over 18,000bn, consistent with the ~18tn already carried. A PERIOD TRAP INSIDE THE SOURCE, DISARMED. The same summary gives 'margin lending brought 1,904bn, ~3x YoY, 27% of total revenue'. Against Q2 revenue of 4,098bn, 1,904 would be 46.5%, NOT 27% - the figures are internally inconsistent as a quarter. They reconcile as H1: 1,904 is 27% of an H1 revenue near 7,000bn. SO 1,904 IS AN H1 FIGURE SITTING IN A LIST OF Q2 FIGURES and was not used. The Q2 lending-interest line of 1,024bn is the quarterly one. CONFIDENCE NOT MOVED (0.55). The earnings-quality picture is now much better evidenced, but what it reveals is a test that cannot be evaluated rather than a resolved fact about the business. Moving the scalar would imply a judgment the evidence does not support. Nothing modelled.
actuals._VPX_OWNS_ELEVEN_PERCENT_OF_CAEX_AND_THE:
STRUCTURE SWEEP, PASS 5. THE FILE HAS CARRIED A 'CAEX OPTION' ON THIS NAME SINCE INCEPTION, WITH BRANCH PROBABILITIES, AN EV OF ABOUT +4.8% ON THE PRICE, AN ARMED KILL CRITERION AND A 1,097bn INJECTION - AND NO OWNERSHIP PERCENTAGE ANYWHERE. CAEX'S SHAREHOLDER STRUCTURE IS VPBANKS 11%, FUTURE LAND INVESTMENT 39%, LYNKID CORPORATION 50%. VPX OWNS ELEVEN PERCENT.

AND THREE NUMBERS FROM THREE SOURCES NOW TIE EXACTLY, WHICH IS WHY THIS IS TRUSTED. CAEX MET A MINIMUM CAPITAL REQUIREMENT OF 10,000bn. ELEVEN PERCENT OF 10,000bn IS 1,100bn. THIS FILE ALREADY HELD caex_q1_investment_bn = 1,097. THE THREE RECONCILE TO 0.27%.

THAT ALSO VINDICATES A JUDGMENT CALL MADE ON 31-JULY AND SCORES IT. That entry found a source stating total CAEX capital as '10 ty dong' immediately after describing a 1,097bn injection, and reasoned: 'those cannot both be right - a 1,097bn injection cannot leave total capital at 10bn - so the total is almost certainly a compression error for a figure ~1,000x LARGER. THE INJECTION FIGURE IS KEPT AND THE TOTAL IS DISCARDED.' THE INFERRED FIGURE WAS ~10,000bn AND THE ACTUAL REQUIREMENT IS 10,000bn. RIGHT, AND RIGHT FOR THE STATED REASON.

AND IT CLOSES A 'NOT ESTABLISHED' FLAG ELSEWHERE IN THE FILE - BY PROVING A DOUBLE COUNT. The vpb block records: 'VPB has put 1,100bn into a TOKENISED-ASSET EXCHANGE. That touches the CAEX crypto-licence option carried on VPX. WHETHER THIS IS THE SAME VENTURE IS NOT ESTABLISHED AND IS NOT ASSUMED.' IT IS THE SAME MONEY. The proof is the structure: 11 + 39 + 50 = 100, SO THERE IS NO ROOM FOR A SEPARATE VPB STAKE, and 11% of 10,000bn is 1,100bn - exactly VPB's figure and within 0.27% of VPX's. TWO ENTRIES IN THIS FILE HAVE BEEN DESCRIBING ONE INVESTMENT AT PARENT AND SUBSIDIARY LEVEL. The refusal to assume was correct at the time and is now discharged with an arithmetic proof rather than an inference.

WHAT THE 11% DOES TO THE SIZE OF THE BET, STATED AS A QUESTION BECAUSE THE BRANCHES ARE HUMAN-ONLY. VPX'S STAKE IS ~1,100bn AGAINST A MARKET CAP OF 49,875bn - 2.21% OF VPX, AND 0.06% OF THE BOOK. THE MODEL'S CAEX OPTION IS WORTH +4.8% OF VPX'S PRICE IN EXPECTATION, WHICH IS 2,394bn. ON AN 11% STAKE, EARNING 2,394bn OF EXPECTED VALUE ON TOP OF A 1,097bn COST IMPLIES AN EXPECTED CAEX EQUITY VALUE OF ABOUT 31,700bn - 3.2x ITS CHARTER CAPITAL - AND SINCE THE EV IS NET OF A REJECTION BRANCH, THE LICENCE-GRANTED BRANCH REQUIRES MORE THAN THAT. TWO READINGS AND I DO NOT CHOOSE BETWEEN THEM: (a) THE BRANCHES PRICE THE STAKE'S NAV, in which case 3.2x charter capital is the embedded assumption and it has never been written down; (b) THE BRANCHES PRICE A RE-RATING OF VPX ITSELF - a licensed first-mover exchange inside the group could move the multiple by more than the stake is worth - in which case the arithmetic above does not apply and the option is a narrative bet, not a NAV bet. CHARTER s4: BRANCH CONSTRUCTION IS HUMAN-ONLY. WHAT IS NEW AND CERTAIN IS THAT THE STAKE IS 11%, AND THE FILE PREVIOUSLY IMPLIED NOTHING AT ALL.

A FOURTH ARMED CRITERION WITH A PROBLEM, AND THIS ONE IS DIFFERENT IN KIND. VPX's second test reads 'THE FREE OPTION EXPIRES WORTHLESS - CAEX LICENCE REJECTED UNDER THE 5-LICENCE CAP'. CAEX IS ONE OF FIVE ENTERPRISES WITH COMPLETE AND VALID DOSSIERS. IF THE CAP IS FIVE AND THERE ARE FIVE VALID APPLICANTS, REJECTION *UNDER THE CAP* IS CLOSE TO UN-FIREABLE - a rejection would have to come on merits, which is not what the criterion says. THE PREVIOUS THREE DEFECTS FOUND THIS WEEK WERE UNDEFINED SUBJECTS (TCB's 'Masterise', VPX's gross-versus-net FVTPL, KDH's consolidation basis). THIS ONE IS A NAMED MECHANISM THAT MAY NOT BE THE OPERATIVE RISK. Human-only under s4; flagged, not rewritten.

TIMING, AND IT HAS SLIPPED. The plan was a licence and operations BY END-Q2/2026. As of April CAEX was still applying. The government now targets the first official crypto-market activity in Q3/2026 with licensing early in the quarter. TODAY IS 05-AUGUST AND Q3 IS 36 DAYS OLD. Calibration forecast #8 carries 'CAEX licence granted ~Q3 at p=0.40' and REMAINS OPEN AND UNSCORED; it now has 56 days left to resolve.

actuals._BEAR_BRANCH_MAY_NOT_BE_BEARISH_ENOUGH_2: VCBS forecasts HPG FY2026 NPAT of 18,055bn (+17%) on revenue of 194,330bn. Our BEAR branch is 18,061bn. A 0.03% match - which is either strong agreement or a basis mismatch, and the difference decides whether there is a finding here at all. OURS IS CORE, ex the 4,123bn Pho Noi divestment gain. VCBS's is almost certainly TOTAL: the forecast is dated ~19-Jun, AFTER Q1 in which that gain was booked as an actual, and a broker forecasting full-year reported NPAT after Q1 has to include it unless it says otherwise. ON THAT READING, like for like: VCBS core = 18,055 - 4,123 = 13,932bn, which is 23% BELOW OUR WORST CASE. The most conservative broker on the street would be well under our bear branch. INDEPENDENT CROSS-CHECK from the spread bridge, which was built without reference to any broker: Q1 core 5,046 + Q2 3.5mt at 1.60-1.86m/t + H2 7-9mt at the spot margin of 0.60-0.68m/t gives an FY core of roughly 14,800-16,800bn. That sits BETWEEN VCBS-core and our bear. SO THREE ROUTES POINT THE SAME WAY - the bridge at spot prices, VCBS adjusted to core, and the arithmetic above - and all three say the 18,061bn bear branch is NOT BEARISH ENOUGH. This is the same conclusion the spot_persists recommendation reached on 26-Jul from the per-tonne side, now reached from the full-year side. THE IF THAT MATTERS: if VCBS's 18,055 is itself core, it matches our bear exactly and none of this holds. That is the less likely reading but it is not impossible, and it is settled by looking at whether VCBS's FY25 base of ~15,432bn (18,055/1.17) is a core or reported figure. NOT RESOLVED. NOTHING CHANGED - branches, probabilities and confidence all stand. Adding or lowering a branch is a judgment call reserved for a human, and doing it on an inferred basis mismatch would be worse than leaving it. Recorded because HPG reports within days and this is the direction of the risk.
